summary: Day 14 testing complete — Kingbuilt /predictor/rip endpoint, DUB STREAK award-weekly admin endpoint, recent-awards public endpoint, and pro_until honor all working correctly. 14/14 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified with Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/predictor/rip returns 8 cards with correct structure: {cards, landed_a_hit, hit_probability, summary, usage}
HIT card correctly placed at climax slot (last position) when landed_a_hit=true
Mystery placeholders have is_mystery=true and 'Mystery X Card' naming pattern
Invalid pack_id correctly returns 404 'Pack not found'
Rate limit returns 429 with exact paywall copy: "You hit the limit, kid. Go Pro or wait 'til next week to find your next DUB."
POST /api/leaderboard/award-weekly: anonymous → 401, non-admin → 403, admin → 200 with correct response structure
award-weekly is idempotent: second call same week returns already_awarded=true
GET /api/leaderboard/recent-awards is public and returns {awards, count}
_user_tier correctly honors pro_until: future date → 'pro', past date → 'free'
Legacy /predictor/simulate endpoint still works for backward compatibility
Frontend Analyzer ConfidenceBadge popover shows 'HOW THIS GETS SMARTER' header + 3 tier rungs + 'X more pulls' nudge
Frontend Predictor shows ripping animation, 8 cards with HIT badge on climax slot, and RIP RECAP summary with Hit/Mystery Cards/Est. Value/vs MSRP stats
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day 14 features fully tested: (1) POST /api/predictor/rip returns 8 cards with HIT at climax slot + Mystery placeholders + verbatim paywall copy on 429. (2) POST /api/leaderboard/award-weekly is admin-only (401 anon, 403 non-admin) and idempotent per ISO week. Returns {week_key, winners:[{rank, user_id, username, thumbs_total, pro_until, reward_days:14}], reward_days:14, already_awarded:bool}. (3) GET /api/leaderboard/recent-awards is public. (4) _user_tier honors pro_until: if tier='pro' but pro_until is past, returns 'free'. (5) Frontend Analyzer ConfidenceBadge popover has 'HOW THIS GETS SMARTER' + 3 tier rungs (Market Only / Market Verified / Community Hardened) + 'X more pulls' nudge. (6) Frontend Predictor shows ripping animation, deals 8 cards with HIT badge + flame icon on last card if landed_a_hit, summary shows Hit/Mystery Cards/Est. Value/vs MSRP. Admin user must have role='admin' in db.users for award-weekly to work.
